label: Mrknutí na kameru
desc: Pohled do kamery, hravé mrknutí jedním okem, tichý smích.
desc_en: A look into the camera, a playful wink with one eye, a silent laugh.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: the person looks straight into the camera as their head tilts slightly to one side, a faint smile forming, and ends holding the look
the person winks one eye with a playful smile, eyebrow lifting, then opens the eye again and holds the smile
the person laughs softly, eyes creasing and shoulders dropping as the person relaxes, then the laugh fades into a warm steady gaze at the camera
